abstraction_design.rationale: Abstractions map well to the real variation (one card system, one moves-table system, shared Section/badges) and stretch to new cases without copy-paste, but there is mild flag creep (showTypes, hidden) and a duplicated card view model.

findings.issue: The ability page's 'Hidden ability' badge is baked into the generic PokemonCard/CardVM (data.ts:89,99,117), entangling a single feature with shared components and CSS (app.css:332).
findings.suggestion: Render the hidden-ability note at the ability page (e.g., a generic `note` slot on the card list) or pass a render-prop, and keep CardVM free of ability-specific fields.

findings.issue: EvoNode is a hand-copied re-declaration of data.ts:226's (unexported) EvoNodeVM; the two must be kept in sync manually.
findings.suggestion: Export EvoNodeVM from lib/data.ts and import it in the route.

findings.issue: The 'English name, else humanize' display rule is duplicated nine times (data.ts:38,147,184,188,252,384,415,429,452).
findings.suggestion: Add a `displayName(record)` helper in format.ts (plus a `typeName(map, name)` variant) and use it everywhere.

findings.issue: All API entities are `any` (24 annotations) in a strict-mode project, so new data work (new fields, renamed API fields, typo'd names) gets no compiler help.
findings.suggestion: Define minimal interfaces for the resources actually consumed (species, pokemon, move, ability, type) and type apiGet<T>.

findings.issue: The type-badge Link markup/class/data-type attribute is re-implemented instead of reusing the TypeBadge component from components.tsx.
findings.suggestion: Import TypeBadge in MovesTable so badge markup and behaviour have one source.

findings.issue: Redundant `data.catalog as CatalogEntry[]` cast, caused by CatalogEntry (data.ts:127) duplicating the CardVM shape rather than extending it.
findings.suggestion: Make CatalogEntry extend CardVM (or have buildHomeData emit CardVM[]) and drop the cast.

findings.issue: The NotFound page is registered twice (router defaultNotFoundComponent and __root.tsx:17 notFoundComponent), and NotFoundPage.tsx:5 sets the title by rendering a <title> inside the page body.
findings.suggestion: Keep one registration and manage the not-found title via head management (or export a head() alongside the component).

findings.issue: Home filtering, pagination and ordering are computed in the route component, while every other page shapes data server-side in lib/data.ts — two conventions for the same kind of work.
findings.suggestion: Either move filtering/pagination into a data-layer helper or document the split (URL state client, catalog server) at the top of the route.

findings.issue: Grab-bag file name 'components.tsx' next to a per-component 'MovesTable.tsx' gives no rule for where the next component goes.
findings.suggestion: Split Section/TypeBadge/PokemonCard/CardList into named files (or rename to cards.tsx + section.tsx) so new components have an obvious home.

summary: This is a well-layered TanStack Start app whose editability rests on real seams: one fetch/cache module, one card builder, one sprite helper, one moves-table component, and thin route files over server functions that match the current stable APIs. The recurring deductions are small but real: a feature-specific flag on the shared card model, a hand-copied evolution-node type, nine duplicated display-name fallbacks, and `any`-typed API data. All five change scenarios land in one to three obvious files.

scenarios.change: Remove the Abilities pages and all links to them
scenarios.notes: Route file and its server fn/data builder delete cleanly, but the 'hidden ability' concept is threaded through the shared card view model, builder parameter, component and CSS, so leaving dead code behind is easy to do.

scenarios.change: Fix a wrong sprite for species whose default Pokémon has a different name (e.g. Deoxys)
scenarios.notes: Every card list derives its sprite through spriteUrl() (api.ts:34), called only from cardsForPokemonRefs and buildHomeData, so one fix covers all four lists. If the fix needs the Pokémon record's own sprite field, it widens to both card builders plus the CardVM/CatalogEntry models, since the builders currently only hold ids.

scenarios.change: Add sorting by name to every list of Pokémon cards
scenarios.notes: CardList is the single render seam for all lists, so one sort there covers everything; otherwise the three server-side lists share cardsForPokemonRefs (data.ts:97) and only the home list's ordering in index.tsx needs a separate edit.

scenarios.change: Add an Items section (/items, /items/:name) shaped like Moves
scenarios.notes: The recipe is formulaic (one route file, one builder, one createServerFn) and Section/CardList/TypeBadge/format helpers and the fact-list CSS are directly reusable; only the ~55 lines of page glue from moves.$name.tsx are copied rather than shared.

scenarios.change: Change the API base URL and caching rules
scenarios.notes: apiBase(), the promise cache, the error mapping and the sprite base URL all live in one 36-line file; nothing else in the app knows the base URL or cache policy.
